title: Segmentify pricing - Per-feature subscription starting at €149/month
clean_text: Segmentify pricing starts at €149 per month, billed per feature, with a free trial available and no credit card required to begin. No free permanent plan is offered. The platform claims an average 9 times return on investment for customers, with free integration and widget design included at signup. Custom enterprise quotes are available directly through the vendor for larger deployments.
